measurement_option.generation_effect: None->Some is committed with measurement finalize; drc source generation remains0.
measurement_option.no_default: No source can run while None; never synthesize a U5 before an admitted finalized measurement.

metadata_override_fifo.records: Python logical int[4], selected values remain [0,0,0,0]; no physical storage-width claim

excluded_from_drc_root.ordinary_input_history: GTC shared-analysis/F07 owner; DRC consumes SharedAnalysisReceipt and never gathers or advances this history.
excluded_from_drc_root.programme_measurement_receipt: Top-level immutable shared GTC input, not duplicated in DRC owner state.
excluded_from_drc_root.static_coefficients: Immutable approved provider/configuration input, not mutable owner state.
excluded_from_drc_root.opaque_category5_packet_bytes: Separate packet path; selected category5/32/1 does not write the DRC control FIFO.

canonical_preimage.rules: F06WH-compatible UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, compact comma/colon separators, no BOM/newline, finite values only. F32 values are exact U32 words; full nested arrays are serialized. JSON integers use exact base-10; booleans are rejected for integer fields.
canonical_preimage.scope: Standalone owners.drc value only; GTC owner envelope (id/generation/state_ref) and top-level MeasurementReceipt remain outside.
canonical_preimage.hash: Existing GTC state_sha256/cold_sha256 only; no additional digest.

transaction.source_clock: GTC drc owner generation equals successfully committed codec-source count. Source0 and1 advance DRC even though AU publication is suppressed; callbacks0/1 have no codec source and do not advance DRC.
transaction.parent_commit: F06ND returns staged next DRC value. GTC parent source/callback root swap alone commits it.
transaction.failure_reset_eof: Fatal discards staged root and preserves committed before state, retires attempt, requires full programme restart and remeasurement; no DRC-only EOF flush.

scope: Pure owner-root representation proposal; no DRC math replay, implementation integration, product or filesystem execution.
